_comment: AI compute pricing (Macro tab section 'compute' and the marketing tab's macro block). gpus: the Ornn Compute Price Index (OCPI) GPUs; ornn = the name in Ornn's free history endpoint (data.ornn.com/api/public-index/gpu/<ornn>/index-history, the trailing 3 months of daily settles; the stored series grows from the first run), page = the Ornn market page, pm = the GPU's prefix in Polymarket's monthly 'average rental price' markets (slug <pm>-average-rental-price-in-<month>-<year>). momentum: fast/slow = moving averages in days; the trend turns up or down when fast/slow - 1 crosses +-band, band = max(band_min, band_k x the day-to-day noise of that GPU's index), and stays until it crosses the other side (so a noisy index does not flip daily). surge = a sharp week: the 7-day average vs the week before, at least max(surge, surge_k x noise). pm_shift = Polymarket's implied price for the nearest month moved this much in a week. alert_days = a signal older than this (in data days) when first seen is history, not news, and is not emailed.
